How I like to explain it is by trying to imagine that you can charge up drifts in 2 states:
if you drift tight, its faster
if you drift wide, its slower.
Somewhere between these 2 mechanices, there needs to be a point where it switches from slow to fast charging. And Softdrifting tries to find the widest spot, where the faster charge is still possible.
Thats atleast how I understand it.
